explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says: if `u` has a limit along one radial ray at `a`, and the diameters of the images of the spheres around `a` shrink to 0, then `u` has that limit on the punctured neighbourhood of `a`. I grepped Mathlib/Topology for `radial`, `diam_image_sphere` and `tendsto_of_tendsto_diam`, and all of Mathlib for `diam (... '' sphere ...)`. None of these searches returned a match. The proof combines several general lemmas (`tendsto_norm_sub_self_nhdsNE`, `squeeze_zero'`, `dist_le_diam_of_mem`, `tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero`) in a multi-step argument, so it is not a one-line special case of a single declaration.
